title: The repo-contract scanner pack runs only at ship, so a raw git test fixture passes build and two audits and fails at ship (cycle 1745)
summary: Cycle 1745 (wave 30, 2026-09-29) added go/internal/cyclesimulator/characterization_test.go with a raw `git init` fixture. The build self-check ran the changed package's tests, the audit and its correction re-audit passed (the ACS suite does not run the raw-git ratchet), and only ship's repo-contract fixed scanner pack ran rawgitratchet.TestRatchet_NoNewRawGitFixtures, which went RED ('pushing would red main'); recovery routed to a re-audit (recover:precondition-reaudit). Neither the builder nor the tdd-engineer persona says fixtures use internal/gittest. The pack's suites are cheap and deterministic, so running them at build exit would have let the builder fix it before any audit.
fix: Run the repo-contract fixed scanner pack (the same suite list ship uses, one source) at build exit as part of the build handoff floor, so a RED goes to the build correction with the failing test named, before the audit. State in the builder and tdd-engineer personas that git-backed test fixtures use gittest.Fixture / Bare / Clone (the raw-git ratchet enforces it).
acceptance: A build that adds a raw git init fixture is corrected at build exit with the ratchet's failing test named, never reaching the audit (red today: cycle 1745 reached ship)
The pack's suite list has one home shared by the build floor and ship
The builder and tdd-engineer personas name gittest for git-backed fixtures
source: console, 2026-09-29, wave-30 cycle 1745 ship gate RED
